ex.en: Salt water contains sodium and chloride ions.
ex.zh: 鹽水含有鈉離子和氯離子。

ex.en: An ion has a positive or negative charge.

ion.en: an atom or small particle that has an electric charge

ex.en: Seaweed and salt often contain iodine.
The nurse cleaned the cut with iodine.
ex.zh: 護理師用碘酒清潔了傷口。

ex.en: Table salt is an ionic compound.
ex.zh: 食鹽是一種離子化合物。

ex.en: Ionic bonds form when atoms give or take electrons.
ex.zh: 當原子失去或得到電子時，就會形成離子鍵。

ex.en: The temple is supported by tall Ionic columns.
ex.zh: 這座神殿由高大的愛奧尼亞式圓柱支撐。

ex.en: Ionic capitals are easy to spot because of their scroll shapes.
ex.zh: 愛奧尼亞式柱頭因為有渦卷形狀而容易辨認。
